en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 398 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Himam from Hasan bin Ali from Aquli from Hasan bin Ali bin Abu Hamza from his father from Abu Basir from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:

“When Imam Qaim (a.s) reappears, people will refuse to believe in him and he will approach them as a young man. However, the believer from whom the Almighty Allah has taken a covenant in Aalame Zar (in the initial stage of creation) will believe immediately.”
